EU CODE 95 & DRIVER CARD
Everything You Should Know
One of the most common questions asked by international professional truck drivers is:
"Can I obtain the EU Code 95 Qualiﬁcation and the Driver Card?"
The answer is:
Yes – in most cases, this is a normal and achievable part of starting your
professional career in Germany.
There is no reason to be afraid of this process.
What Is the EU Code 95 Qualiﬁcation?
The EU Code 95 Qualiﬁcation is a professional qualiﬁcation required for many
commercial truck drivers operating within the European Union.
Its purpose is to ensure that professional drivers understand important topics such as:
• Road safety
• Professional driving techniques
• Traffic regulations
• Fuel-efficient driving
• Health and safety
• Emergency procedures
• Customer service
The qualiﬁcation helps improve safety for both drivers and other road users.

Can International Drivers Obtain Code 95?
Yes.
Every year, thousands of international professional drivers successfully obtain the
required qualiﬁcation.
There are many specialised training providers throughout Germany and Europe that offer
Code 95 training for professional drivers.
Depending on the applicable legal regulations, parts of the theoretical training may also
be available in an online format.
Your employer or EuroJobsCenter can provide guidance regarding the available options.

Do Not Be Afraid
Many drivers believe that obtaining Code 95 is extremely difficult.
This is usually not true.
Like any professional qualiﬁcation, it requires time, commitment and successful
completion of the required training.
With the right attitude and proper preparation, it is generally an achievable process.

What Is the Driver Card?
The Driver Card (Digital Tachograph Card) is a personal electronic card used together
with the digital tachograph installed in commercial vehicles.
The card records important driving information, including:
• Driving time
• Rest periods
• Working time
• Vehicle activities
The Driver Card helps ensure compliance with European driving and rest time
regulations.

subsection_title: Why Is the Driver Card Important?
text:
Why Is the Driver Card Important?
The Driver Card protects both the driver and the employer.
It provides an accurate record of professional driving activities and helps demonstrate
compliance with legal working time requirements.
Every professional driver should use the card responsibly and in accordance with the
law.

Support During the Process
Your employer and EuroJobsCenter will explain the necessary steps required for your
individual situation.
If additional documents or training are required, you will receive guidance throughout
the process.
Do not hesitate to ask questions whenever something is unclear.
Building Your Professional Qualiﬁcations
Many successful truck drivers continue improving their qualiﬁcations throughout their
careers.
After obtaining Code 95 and the Driver Card, you may later choose to expand your
professional skills by obtaining additional qualiﬁcations such as:
• ADR (Dangerous Goods)
• Tanker Transport
• Heavy Haulage
• Crane Operation
• Forklift Licence
Additional qualiﬁcations may improve your career opportunities and increase your
earning potential.

Remember
Do not allow fear or uncertainty to discourage you.
Every year, many international drivers successfully complete these requirements and
begin rewarding careers in Germany.
Think of Code 95 and the Driver Card as an investment in your professional future.
They are not obstacles.
They are important steps towards becoming a successful professional truck driver in
Germany.

OUR MESSAGE
Professional qualiﬁcations create professional opportunities.
Stay positive.
Keep learning.
Ask questions whenever necessary.
With determination and the right support, you can build a successful long-term career in
Germany.
